sc_4_3_approach: CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT that sc-4-1's change does NOT fix lastWriteWinsByKey (rankIsGreater({attempts:10},{attempts:9}) still returned false, since BranchStatus carries neither version nor updatedAt). Fix: WIDENED versionRank's first term to fall back to a numeric `attempts` field when `version` is absent, and switched lastWriteWinsByKey.merge to higherRanked. Rationale: it is the only option that does not touch a writer (giving BranchStatus its own version field would require editing branchRecord and every branchStatus writer, forbidden by nonGoal 1), and is safe by construction since no other channel value carries `attempts`.
